summary: Frontend-only smoke of the redesigned /dashboard (Emergent style) and /admin universe snapshot flows. All requested flows pass: overview metrics, quota panel, upgrade modal (3 tiers) from both quota-upgrade-btn and quota-chip, key create/revoke, new-key-banner + copy, autotopup toggle, alert threshold change (toast), email-statement graceful toast (backend 503 -> UI toast), key-usage-graph empty state, ChatDemo/Playground, Quickstart CodeTabs, Models list, Email history, Pricing section. Admin: LINQ renamed correctly (row text 'LINQ' — no 'LINQ Universe' anywhere), snapshot save shows toast 'Snapshot saved: LINQ @ tick 20', Tick x10 advances tick 20->30, snapshot-restore reverts tick 30->20 exactly (verified in table), snapshot-delete works (chips row clears to 'No snapshots yet'), Dissolve on 'Kess Verdant' succeeds without touching Frasberg/Luchii/LINQ.

minor.issue: Returns 503 (email sending domain not verified). This is expected/graceful — UI shows toast 'Email delivery is currently restricted until our sending domain is verified. Your statement attempt was logged.' No action required unless production emails are meant to send.

issues: React DOM hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' at /app/frontend/src/components/site/ChatDemo.jsx line ~547 (voice speed select). Cosmetic dev-console warning caused by wrapping option text in a data-ve-dynamic <span>; does not break UI but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Wrap the voice-speed <option> label in ChatDemo.jsx line ~547 so the <option> child is a plain text node instead of a <span>, to remove the React hydration warning.
(Optional) If production email statements are expected to actually send, verify the sender domain so /api/receipts/send-now stops returning 503.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx (~505 lines) is at the upper end but still single-file manageable; consider splitting KeysPanel, QuotaPanel, and OverviewMetrics into subcomponents if it grows further.
In generate() the 402 branch redirects to /pay via setTimeout — good UX, but no cleanup of the timer if the component unmounts. Minor.
refresh() uses Promise.all with individual .then((r)=> r.ok ? r.json() : []) — swallows errors silently. Consider surfacing per-endpoint failures in dev.
Admin cloud panel correctly guards Frasberg/Luchii/LINQ from delete via UI list (verified during dissolve test).
